classes.name: BBjServletData
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, the BBjServletData object allows your program to register callbacks for incoming web requests.

When the webserver first receives a request registered with the BBjServletRegistry, an interpreter will be started with the registered BBjAppConfig. That application then registers handlers for callback events. BBjServletData provides a handle to the internal configuration for registering callbacks.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjservletdata/bbjservletdata.htm)

classes.name: BBjInterpreter
classes.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher the BBjInterpreter object provides access to selected BBj interpreter functionality through a Java API. This allows Java code to invoke interpreter-level operations such as executing BBj commands, calling BBj programs, and managing interpreter behavior without direct access to the BBj language.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter.htm)

methods.name: isInterpreterContext
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher determines whether the current thread is executing within the BBjInterpreter context.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_isInterpreterContext.htm)

methods.name: executeInInterpreterContext
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher executes a Java Callable in the BBjInterpreter context. If called from the interpreter thread, the Callable executes immediately; otherwise, it is dispatched to the interpreter context and executed asynchronously, a BBjException is thrown if the Callable cannot be dispatched to the interpreter context or if execution fails.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_executeInInterpreterContext.htm)

methods.name: processEvents
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher processes BBj events and blocks until all pending events have been handled. This method behaves like the BBj PROCESS_EVENTS verb.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_processEvents.htm)

methods.name: processPendingEvents
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher processes all pending BBj events without blocking, except for the time required to execute event callbacks.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_processPendingEvents.htm)

methods.name: waitVerb
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher causes the BBjInterpreter to wait for the specified fractional number of seconds. This method behaves like the BBj WAIT verb.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_waitVerb.htm)

methods.name: eval
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, evaluates the specified BBj command string in the BBjInterpreter context and returns the result. This method behaves like the BBj EVAL function. A BBjException is thrown if the command cannot be evaluated or execution fails.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_eval.htm)

methods.name: call
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher calls a BBj program with the specified arguments in the BBjInterpreter context and returns the updated argument values. This method behaves like the BBj CALL verb. A BBjException is thrown if the program cannot be executed or execution fails.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_call.htm)

methods.name: release
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher exits the BBjInterpreter. When no exit value is specified, the interpreter exits with a status of 0. This method behaves like the BBj RELEASE verb with no arguments. A BBjException is thrown if the interpreter cannot be released.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_release.htm)

methods.name: release
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher exits the BBjInterpreter. When no exit value is specified, the interpreter exits with a status of 0. This method behaves like the BBj RELEASE verb with no arguments. A BBjException is thrown if the interpreter cannot be released.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_release.htm)

methods.name: setEsc
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher sets the escape handler to an object method that takes no arguments. The BBjinterpreter automatically performs a RETRY when the method returns normally. If this behavior is not desired, the method should either call RELEASE or throw an exception. Setting object to null will clear the BBj SETESC.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_setEsc.htm)

methods.name: setErr
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher sets the error handler to an object method that takes no arguments. The BBjInterpreter automatically performs a RETRY when the method returns normally. If this behavior is not desired, the method should either call RELEASE or throw an exception. Setting the object to null will clear the BBj SETERR.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjInterpreter/BBjInterpreter_setErr.htm)

classes.name: BBjServletConfiguration
classes.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, BBj Servlets can be programmatically configured though the AdminAPI.

This class is used to configure a BBjServlet that will be automatically deployed within a BBjJettyContextConfiguration. The configuration comprises 3 elements

  • NAME - will form part of the URL

  • PROGRAM - the source file containing the servlet code

  • CONFIG - the BBj configuration file to use during execution

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjservletconfiguration/BBjServletConfiguration.htm)

methods.name: setSourceFileName

classes.name: BBjFileUpload
classes.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, BBjFileUpload contains all of the information related to files uploaded to a Servlet.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload.htm)

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the HTML element posted to the servlet with a BBjFileUpload object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getFieldName.htm)

methods.name: getTempName
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method gets the full name and path location for the temporary file has been stored in a BBjFileUpload object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getTempName.htm)

methods.name: getContentType
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the mime type of the uploaded file in a BBjFileUpload object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getContentType.htm)

methods.name: getContentLength
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the length (in bytes) of the file uploaded in a BBjFileUpload object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getContentLength.htm)

methods.name: getOriginalName
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the original file name from a BBjFileUpload object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjfileupload/BBjFileUpload_getOriginalName.htm)

classes.name: BBjPrinter
classes.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, a BBjPrinter object allows the user to select a printer and start printing.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/bbjprinter.htm)

methods.name: getForm
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method obtains a BBjForm object for the currently selected printer.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/bbjprinter_getform.htm)

methods.name: setNative
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.12 and higher, this method sets whether or not the native printer driver is used.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/BBjPrinter_setNative.htm)

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets the javax.print.attribute.PrintRequest attributes for documents.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/bbjprinter_setattributes.htm)

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.docu:
Obtains the user set of javax.print.attribute.PrintRequest attributes for the documents.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprinter/bbjprinter_getattributes.htm)

methods.name: getNonStandardAttribute
methods.docu: create a special platform specific attribute.

classes.name: BBjRuntime
classes.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, BBjRuntime provides methods through which a program may interact with its runtime environment.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime.htm)

methods.name: doGC
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method causes the JVM to do a garbage collection.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_dogc.htm)

methods.name: getBBjStack
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector of BBjStackElement.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_getbbjstack.htm)

methods.name: getBBjStackTrace
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns a string representing the BBj stack trace.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_getbbjstacktrace.htm)

methods.name: getDebugState
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns whether the debug state of the current interpreter is on.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_getdebugstate.htm)

methods.name: getMemStatString
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns a string containing information about the current memory usage of the JVM.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_getmemstatstring.htm)

methods.name: getClientMemoryString
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a string containing information about the current memory usage of the client JVM.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/BBjRuntime_getClientMemoryString.htm)

methods.name: isClientInServerJVM
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns whether the client is running in the same JVM as the server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_isclientinserverjvm.htm)

methods.name: isDVKLicenseActive
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns whether BBjServices is using a DVK (development kit) license.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_isdvklicenseactive.htm)

methods.name: setDebugState
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the debug state of the current interpreter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_setdebugstate.htm)

methods.name: isDebugging
methods.docu:
Returns whether the interpreter is being run in a debugger.

Returns: true if this interpreter is being run in a debugger, false otherwise.

methods.name: isConsoleInteractive
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method returns whether the console in this BBj session is capable of providing a READY prompt to the user. If this method returns true, if the program executes an ESCAPE or if the program encounters an uncaught error, it will attempt to print the READY prompt, subject to the constraints defined by STBL("!CONEXIT"). If this method returns false, executing an ESCAPE or encountering an uncaught error will cause this BBj session to terminate.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjruntime/bbjruntime_isconsoleinteractive.htm)

classes.name: BBjBuiNoneCloseAction
classes.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, the BBjBuiNoneCloseAction object provides an interface to configure no action on termination of a BUI or DWC application.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction.htm)

methods.name: getActionType
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an integer constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_NONE).

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction_getActionType.htm)

methods.name: getActionTypeString
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an string constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_NONE).

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction/BBjBuiNoneCloseAction_getActionTypeString.htm)

classes.name: BBjConfig
classes.docu:
A BBjConfig object provides programmatic access to some configuration items.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig.htm)

methods.name: getCommandLineObject
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjCommandLineObject.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getcommandlineobject.htm)

methods.name: getCommandLineObject
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjCommandLineObject.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getcommandlineobject.htm)

methods.name: getCompatibilitySetting
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method retrieves !COMPAT values from STBL() functions.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getcompatibilitysetting.htm)

methods.name: getConfigFileName
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method returns the name of the configuration file used by the current Interpreter session.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getconfigfilename.htm)

methods.name: getCurrentCommandLineObject
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns the current session's BBjCommandLineObject.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getcurrentcommandlineobject.htm)

methods.name: getOptionSetting
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method retrieves !OPTIONS values from STBL() functions.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getoptionsetting.htm)

methods.name: getSuppressErrorsOnClientObjVoidMethods
methods.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method returns a value indicating whether the Interpreter waits for completion of ClientObject methods that have void return type. If the Interpreter does not wait for completion then any exception that is generated on the client side during the method execution will not generate an error in the users program.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_getsuppresserrorsonclientobjvoidmethods.htm)

methods.name: isClientCentric
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method returns the client centric SETOPTS bit (8,$08$).

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_isclientcentric.htm)

methods.name: isReleaseOnLostConnection
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.01 and higher, this method returns a boolean value that indicates whether the interpreter session will be terminated immediately if the client side of a thin client connection dies unexpectedly.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/BBjConfig_isReleaseOnLostConnection.htm)

methods.name: makeEmptyAppConfig
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjAppConfig object, which can be used to build and publish a BUI BBjApplication.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/BBjConfig_makeEmptyAppConfig.htm)

methods.name: notifyUserOnInternalError
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method controls whether the interpreter notifies the user when it encounters an internal !ERROR=255.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_notifyuseroninternalerror.htm)

methods.name: releaseOnLostConnection
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.01 and higher, this method controls whether to terminate the Interpreter session immediately if the client side of a thin client connection dies unexpectedly.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_releaseonlostconnection.htm)

methods.name: requireAllSendMsgResponses
methods.docu:
This method controls whether the Interpreter waits for a response from certain SENDMSG functions before proceeding with the next program statement.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_requireallsendmsgresponses.htm)

methods.name: setClientCentric
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, this method sets the SETOPTS bit 8,$08$.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_setclientcentric.htm)

methods.name: setCompatibilitySetting
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets !COMPAT values from STBL() functions.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_setcompatibilitysetting.htm)

methods.name: setOptionSetting
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method sets !OPTIONS values from STBL() functions.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_setoptionsetting.htm)

methods.name: suppressErrorsOnClientObjVoidMethods
methods.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method controls whether the Interpreter waits for completion of ClientObject methods that have void return type. If the Interpreter does not wait for completion then any exception that is generated on the client side during the method execution will not generate an error in the users program.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_suppresserrorsonclientobjvoidmethods.htm)

methods.name: suppressPrinterAckBack
methods.docu:
Controls whether the Interpreter waits for a response from the printer before processing the next program statement.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_suppressprinterackback.htm)

methods.name: suppressUIAckBack
methods.docu:
Controls whether the Interpreter waits for a response from UI before processing the next program statement.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_suppressuiackback.htm)

methods.name: unpinSession
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this BBjConfig method unpins all the programs and resources in a given session. Loading these programs or resources again causes BBj to check their timestamp and load a new version on disk, if the timestamp has changed.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_unpinsession.htm)

methods.name: unpinSessionEntity
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this BBjConfig method unpins the specified program or resource. Loading this program or resource again causes BBj to check its timestamp and load a new version on disk, if the timestamp has changed.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_unpinsessionentity.htm)

methods.name: env
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method returns the value of the specified server operating system environment variable. Unlike the ENV function in the language, it does not depend on whether the interpreter is client-centric.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_env.htm)

methods.name: clientEnv
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method returns the value of the specified client operating system environment variable. It throws a BBjException if the variable does not exist.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjconfig/bbjconfig_clientEnv.htm)

classes.name: BBjJettyServerConfiguration
classes.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher this class is used to configure the integrated Jetty Server.

It provides an interface to maintain contexts through the BBjJettyContextConfiguration class.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration.htm)

methods.name: createCustomContext
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method creates a new Context entry in the Jetty web server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_createCustomContext.htm)

methods.name: getCustomContext
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method gets a BBjJettyContextConfiguration for the name's context.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getCustomContext.htm)

methods.name: removeCustomContext
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method removes a Context Entry from the internal Jetty web server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_removeCustomContext.htm)

methods.name: getContextNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVectorcontaining the names of the contexts configured in the Jetty web server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getContextNames.htm)

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method saves the configuration to basis_home/cfg/jetty.xml, overwriting the existing file.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_saveConfig.htm)

methods.name: getRootContextInfo
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method gets a BBjJettyContextConfiguration for the default BBj context.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getRootContextInfo.htm)

methods.name: getEmContextInfo
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method gets a BBjJettyContextConfiguration for the Enterprise Manager context.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getEmContextInfo.htm)

methods.name: setAdminUser
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets the admin user stored in jetty.xml.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_setAdminUser.htm)

methods.name: setAdminPassword
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method sets the admin password stored in jetty.xml.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_setAdminPassword.htm)

methods.name: addMimeType
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method adds a MIME type to jetty.xml.

MIME types are stored as mime-type elements in jetty.xml and are applicable to all contexts.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_addMimeType.htm)

methods.name: removeMimeType
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method removes a MIME type from jetty.xml.

MIME types are stored as mime-type elements in jetty.xml and are applicable to all contexts.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_removeMimeType.htm)

methods.name: getMimeTypes
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing the configured MIME types in jetty.xml.

MIME types are stored as mime-type elements in jetty.xml and are applicable to all contexts.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getMimeTypes.htm)

methods.name: getDefaultSSLPort
methods.docu:
In BBj 26.00 and higher, this method returns a String containing the default SSL Port for the server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_getDefaultSSLPort.htm)

methods.name: setDefaultSSLPort
methods.docu:
In BBj 26.00 and higher, this method sets the default SSL Port for the server. It takes a String containing the port number that will be set to the default SSL port.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_setDefaultSSLPort.htm)

methods.name: refreshSSL
methods.docu:
In BBj 26.02 and higher, this method reloads the SSL certificate/keystore for the specified port on the live server, without restarting BBjServices or dropping existing connections.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserverconfiguration/BBjJettyServerConfiguration_refreshSSL.htm)

classes.name: BBjJdbcOdbcInfo
classes.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, the BBjVector of BBjJdbcOdbcInfo objects provides programmatic access to information about all JDBC and ODBC connections within the current BBjServices environment.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjdbcodbcinfo/bbjjdbcodbcinfo.htm)

methods.name: close
methods.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method closes the JDBC/ODBC connection represented by this object. The client application will not receive any kind of notification regarding the closing of the connection so this may adversely effect the client application.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjdbcodbcinfo/bbjjdbcodbcinfo_close.htm)

methods.name: getConnectTime
methods.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method returns the date and time when one of the JDBC/ODBC connections opened in the BBjServices session.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjdbcodbcinfo/bbjjdbcodbcinfo_getconnecttime.htm)

methods.name: getDatabase
methods.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the database of one of the JDBC/ODBC connections currently open in the BBjServices session.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjdbcodbcinfo/bbjjdbcodbcinfo_getdatabase.htm)

methods.name: getHost
methods.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method returns the connected host name for one of the JDBC/ODBC connections currently open in the BBjServices session.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjdbcodbcinfo/bbjjdbcodbcinfo_gethost.htm)

methods.name: getID
methods.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method returns the unique connection identifier for one of the JDBC/ODBC connections currently open in the BBjServices session.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjdbcodbcinfo/bbjjdbcodbcinfo_getid.htm)

methods.name: getUser
methods.docu:
In BBj 8.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the user who opened one of the JDBC/ODBC connections currently open in the BBjServices session.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjdbcodbcinfo/bbjjdbcodbcinfo_getuser.htm)

classes.name: BBjBusyIndicator
classes.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, the BBjBusyIndicator provides an interface to manipulate an animated busy indicator with a developer-defined message.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator.html)

fields.name: TEXT
fields.docu:
The $text$ tag is used as a placeholder for the busy message
text within the HTML.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the HTML that defines the overall appearance of the busy indicator. The $text$ placeholder indicates where the text from BBjBusyIndicator::setText(string) will be inserted.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_getHtml.html)

methods.name: getText
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the text message set by the developer.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_getText.html)

methods.name: isVisible
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.0 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether the busy indicator is currently visible.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_isVisible.html)

methods.name: setHtml
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method sets the HTML that defines the overall appearance of the busy indicator. The $text$ placeholder indicates where the text from BBjBusyIndicator::setText(String) will be inserted.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_setHtml.html)

methods.name: setText
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method inserts the specified text message into the HTML string at the position indicated by the $text$ place-holder.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_setText.html)

methods.name: setVisible
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, if visible is true, this method places a translucent glass pane over the browser window and makes the busy indicator visible in the middle of the browser. If visible is false, this method removes the glass pane and busy indicator from the browser.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_setVisible.html)

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 22.02 and higher, this method sets a component attribute on the BBjBusyIndicator.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_setAttribute.htm)

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 22.02 and higher, this method returns a component attribute that was previously set withwith BBjBusyIndicator::setAttribute.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_getAttribute.htm)

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.docu: [Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_hasAttribute.htm)

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 22.13 and higher, this method removes a BBjBusyIndicator attribute.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBusyIndicator/BBjBusyIndicator_removeAttribute.htm)

classes.name: BBjNumber
classes.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, the BBjNumber object defines an object-oriented interface to traditional BBx numbers. It is not a java.lang.Number, but it implements the conversion methods defined by that class. This API is primarily designed to facilitate interaction with Java libraries.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjnumber/BBjNumber.htm)

methods.name: booleanValue
methods.docu:

classes.name: BBjForm
classes.docu:
In BBj 4.00 and higher, the BBjForm object allows users to build and print a document on the associated printer.

The BBjForm API provides an object-oriented interface for building forms and reports for printing. It provides a good substitute for using SYSPRINT and PWINDOW for form building. SYSPRINT allows programmers to lay out a form, but requires everything to be explicit. It does not provide any abstraction. PWINDOW provides good abstraction, but the controls are focused more on the needs of a GUI rather than a printed form. The BBjForm API overcomes the shortcomings and limitations of both of these approaches by making available an object-oriented API specifically designed for laying out printed forms and reports.

There is a clear path for using the BBjForm API. First, get the correct printer from BBjAPI and set the appropriate printer options on the resulting BBjPrinter object. Next, obtain a BBjForm object that represents a single printed form, allowing creation of one or more pages of the form. The programmer can lay out each page independently by creating BBjForm objects, setting their attributes, and adding them to the page. When the form is completed, use BBjForm methods to print, preview, or cancel the form.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjform/bbjform.htm)

classes.name: BBjNamespace
classes.docu:
In BBj 3.00 and higher, BBjNamespace provides a mechanism by which two or more BBj programs that are running in the same BBjServices can share data. It also provides methods that allow a program to be notified when that shared data is modified by some other program.

There are three types of BBjNamespaces, each with their own naming convention, level of visibility, and life cycle, with differences in scope and de-allocation of the shared memory.

  • Generic BBjNamespace - scope is global; memory is automatically freed when there are no longer any references.

  • Group BBjNamespace - scope is parent-children (group) interpreter (SCALLED or newBBjSession()) sessions; memory is automatically de-allocated when the group no longer exists

  • Global BBjNamespace - scope is global BBjServices or JVM wide; de-allocation only happens when items are removed from the namespace or restart of BBjServices (no automatic de-allocation)

One of the most common uses for memory record sets is in stored procedures because stored procedures often need to return an SQL result set to the client application. A memory record set gives the developer the ability to create a record set (that the SQL engine later converts to a result set), populate this record set with arbitrary data, and return the record set as the result of the stored procedure call.

methods.name: getHomeDirectory

In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjClientFile that represents the home directory of the user running BBj on the client computer.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfilesystem/bbjclientfilesystem_gethomedirectory.htm)

methods.name: getRoots
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector of BBjClientFile objects that represent the filesystem roots on the client computer.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjclientfilesystem/bbjclientfilesystem_getroots.htm)

classes.name: BBjAppletProxy
classes.docu:
The BBjAppletProxy provides control of the Applet and AppletContext when a BBj program is being run through an Applet.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy.htm)

methods.name: setBounds
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method sets the location and size of a running Applet.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_setbounds.htm)

methods.name: getParam
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method retrieves the value of a parameter that was set within the HTML from which the Applet was launched.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_getparam.htm)

methods.name: showDocument
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays the specified URL in a separate browser frame.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_showdocument.htm)

methods.name: showStatus
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays a message on the browser status bar.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_showstatus.htm)

methods.name: playAudio
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays a specified URL in a separate browser frame.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_playaudio.htm)

methods.name: playAudio
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays a specified URL in a separate browser frame.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_playaudio.htm)

methods.name: addFrame
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method displays a specified URL in a frame within the Applet.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_addframe.htm)

methods.name: removeFrame
methods.docu:
In BBj 2.02 and higher, this method removes a frame that has previously been created through a call to addFrame().

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjappletproxy/bbjappletproxy_removeframe.htm)

classes.name: BBjProgramInfo
classes.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, the BBjProgramInfo object provides programmatic access to information about a program.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo.htm)

methods.name: getListing
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the complete listing for the program referenced by a BBjProgramInfo object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getlisting.htm)

methods.name: getListingVector
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector of strings containing the complete listing for a program referenced by a BBjProgramInfo object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getlistingvector.htm)

methods.name: getListingForLine
methods.docu:
In BBj 22.11 and higher, this method returns the listing for a specified user-defined or physical line of a program referenced by a BBjProgramInfo object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/BBjProgramInfo_getListingForLine.htm)

methods.name: getListingForPhysicalLine
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the listing for a specified physical line of a program referenced by a BBjProgramInfo object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getlistingforphysicalline.htm)

methods.name: getLineCount
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns the number of lines in the program referenced by a BBjProgramInfo object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getlinecount.htm)

methods.name: hasLineNumbers
methods.docu:
In BBj 6.00 and higher, this method returns whether the program referenced by a BBjProgramInfo object has line numbers.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_haslinenumbers.htm)

methods.name: getCanonicalProgramName
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.12 and higher, this method returns the canonical program name for the program referenced by a BBjProgramInfo object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjprograminfo/bbjprograminfo_getCanonicalProgramName.htm)

classes.name: BBjMsgBox
classes.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, the BBjMsgBox object is equivalent to the MSGBOX() Function.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox.htm)

methods.name: button1
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets custom text or HTML for the first button of this BBjMsgBox.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_button1.htm)

methods.name: button2
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets custom text or HTML for the second button of this BBjMsgBox.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_button2.htm)

methods.name: button3
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets custom text or HTML for the third button of this BBjMsgBox.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_button3.htm)

methods.name: message
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the message text or HTML for this BBjMsgBox.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_message.htm)

methods.name: modes
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets assorted options on this BBjMsgBox, corresponding to the MODE= option of the MSGBOX() Function.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_modes.htm)

methods.name: options
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets assorted options on this BBjMsgBox, corresponding to the int expr parameter of the MSGBOX() Function.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_options.htm)

methods.name: show
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method shows the BBjMsgBox dialog and waits for the user to make a selection.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_show.htm)

methods.name: timeout
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the BBjMsgBox timeout in seconds. If not specified, the BBjMsgBox will wait indefinitely for the user to make a selection.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_timeout.htm)

methods.name: title
methods.docu:
In BBj 25.03 and higher, this method sets the title text for this BBjMsgBox dialog.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/BBjMsgBox/BBjMsgBox_title.htm)

classes.name: BBjPrintPreviewBuilder
classes.docu:
In BBj 13.0 and higher, the BBjPrintPreviewBuilder object provides methods for configuring print preview, for example setting the initial view to two pages.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder.html)

methods.name: closeOnPrint
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method overrides the default and keeps preview open. The print preview default is to exit after printing.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_closeOnPrint.html)

methods.name: editPassword
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method sets the editor password, allowing modification of any document saved as a PDF.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_editPassword.html)

methods.name: maximize
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method maximizes the Print Preview window after opening.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_maximize.html)

methods.name: openPassword
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method sets the open password that required to open any document saved as a PDF.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_openPassword.html)

methods.name: preview
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method opens a preview window once configuration is complete.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_preview.html)

methods.name: secure
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method sets secure(0) to override the default, removing all document security. This is useful after saving a PDF as the file is not editable by default.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_secure.html)

methods.name: style
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.0 and higher, this method controls the view style. "HEIGHT" fits a page vertically in the available space, "WIDTH" horizontally in the available space, "TWO" displays two pages side-by-side.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/BBjPrintPreviewBuilder_style.html)

methods.name: zoom
methods.docu:
In BBj 13.00 and higher, this method scales the document to take up more or less space in the preview window; zoom 50 is half size, zoom 200 is double size.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjprint/bbjprintpreviewbuilder/bbjprintpreviewbuilder_zoom.html)

classes.name: BBjApplication
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, the BBjApplication object represents a published BUI application and is immutable. Changes are made through the BBjAppConfig object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/bbjapplication.htm)

methods.name: getApplicationIcon
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjResourceUrl corresponding to the application's icon.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getApplicationIcon.html)

methods.name: getApplicationUserName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application user name, which corresponds to the BBj -n parameter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getApplicationUserName.html)

methods.name: getBBjApplicationName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application name, which corresponds to the BBj -a parameter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getBBjApplicationName.html)

methods.name: getClasspathName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the session classpath for this application.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getClasspathName.html)

methods.name: getClientPollInterval
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this is the number of seconds the web server will wait for the next command from the server. The default value is 50 seconds. If the web server does not receive a command from BBjServices in the configured time period, it will send a heartbeat to the browser.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getClientPollInterval.html)

methods.name: getConfigFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this is the name of the config.bbx file to use for this application.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getConfigFile.html)

methods.name: getDevelopmentMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this BUI app should be run in development mode. The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getDevelopmentMode.htm)

methods.name: getDisallowConsole
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether console access is disallowed.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getDisallowConsole.htm)

methods.name: getEndAction
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the action that will occur on normal application termination.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getEndAction.html)

methods.name: getErrAction
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the action that will occur on abnormal application termination.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getErrAction.html)

methods.name: getInterpreterUser
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the interpreter user name, which corresponds to the BBj -u command line parameter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getInterpreterUser.html)

methods.name: getLoadImage
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjResourceUrl representing the application's load image (splash screen).

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getLoadImage.html)

methods.name: getManageBrowserHistory
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this BUI will manage this app's browser history. The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getManageBrowserHistory.htm)

methods.name: getName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the application as it will be published.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getName.html)

methods.name: getOmitBasisCss
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this BUI app should be run without the default BASIS CSS. The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getOmitBasisCss.htm)

methods.name: getProgramArguments
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector of user-defined program arguments.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getProgramArguments.html)

methods.name: getProgramName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the BBj program name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getProgramName.html)

methods.name: getSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether secure mode was specified for this BBjApplication. The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getSecure.htm)

methods.name: getSessionTimeout
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the length of time in seconds a non-responsive BUI session will be considered active. If the session expires without response, the web-tier will send a NET_DROPPED error back to the server. The default value is 300 seconds (5 minutes). -1 corresponds to no timeout.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getSessionTimeout.html)

methods.name: getShowBrowserWarning
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns whether to display a browser warning the first time the user attempts to run a BUI application in Internet Explorer 8. The default value is true.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getShowBrowserWarning.html)

methods.name: getShowClientConfirmationDialog
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns whether to display a confirmation dialog when the user attempts to leave the application's page. The default value is true.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getShowClientConfirmationDialog.html)

methods.name: getStyleSheet
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjResourceUrl representing the application's style sheet.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getStyleSheet.html)

methods.name: getTerminal
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application's terminal alias.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getTerminal.html)

methods.name: getWorkingDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application's working directory.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_getWorkingDirectory.html)

methods.name: isBuiEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this application is enabled in the BUI client.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_isBuiEnabled.htm)

methods.name: isDwcEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this application is enabled in the DWC client.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_isDwcEnabled.html)

methods.name: isDesktopEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 24.01 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether or not this application is enabled for desktop deployment.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_isDesktopEnabled.htm)

methods.name: isQuiet
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether quiet mode was specified.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_isQuiet.html)

methods.name: toAppConfig
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an editable BBjAppConfig object with the same settings as this immutable BBjApplication.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjapplication/BBjApplication_toAppConfig.html)

classes.name: BBjCommandLineObjectBase
classes.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, the BBjCommandLineObject provides programmatic access
to the command line of the current session, and to configure a new session.

methods.name: getApplicationUserName
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method returns the application user name.

Returns: Application user name specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

methods.name: getClasspathName
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.0 and higher, this method returns the current classpath (-CP) parameter.

Returns: The name that will be passed to the -CP command-line option. To get the original classpath name specified via the -CP argument, use getOriginalClasspathName.

methods.name: getConfigFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method returns the config file specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

Returns: Returns the config file specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

methods.name: getInterpreterUser
methods.docu:
Return the interpreter user name, which corresponds to the BBj -u command line parameter.

Returns: Return the interpreter user name.

methods.name: getProgramName
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method returns the BBj program name specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

Returns: Returns the returns the BBj program name specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

methods.name: getTerminal
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method returns the user specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

Returns: Returns the terminal specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

methods.name: getWorkingDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method returns the working directory specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

Returns: Returns the working directory specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

methods.name: isQuiet
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method returns whether the BBjCommandLineObject specifies quiet mode.

Returns: Returns a boolean indicating whether the BBjCommandLineObject specifies quiet mode.

methods.name: setApplicationUserName
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method sets the application user name that the BBjCommandLineObject specifies.

Parameters:

  • p_username Application user name.

methods.name: setClasspathName
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.0 and higher, this method sets the argument to the -CP command line parameter to BBj.

Parameters:

  • p_classpathName The name of a defined classpath in Enterprise Manager.

methods.name: setConfigFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method sets the config file specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

Parameters:

  • p_config The config file name.

methods.name: setInterpreterUser
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method sets the interpreter user name, which corresponds to the BBj -u command line parameter.

Parameters:

  • p_username The interpreter user name.

methods.name: setProgramName
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method sets the BBj program specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

Parameters:

  • p_program BBj program name.

methods.name: setQuiet
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method sets whether the BBjCommandLineObject specifies quiet mode.

Parameters:

  • p_quiet A boolean indicating whether quiet mode is specified.

methods.name: setTerminal
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method sets the terminal specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

Parameters:

  • p_alias The terminal alias (e.g. T2).

methods.name: setWorkingDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 4.0 and higher, this method sets the working directory specified by the BBjCommandLineObject.

Parameters:

  • p_dir Specifies the working directory.

classes.name: BBjJettyContextController
classes.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this class provides an administrator program the ability to control individual contexts within the running BBJ Web Server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjjettycontextcontroller/BBjJettyContextController.htm)

methods.name: start
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method starts context associated to this BBjJettyContextController.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjjettycontextcontroller/BBjJettyContextController_start.htm)

methods.name: stop
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method stops context associatd to this BBjJettyContextController.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjjettycontextcontroller/BBjJettyContextController_stop.htm)

methods.name: restart
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method restarts context associated to this BBjJettyContextController.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjjettycontextcontroller/BBjJettyContextController_restart.htm)

methods.name: isStarted
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean value that indicates whether the context has been started.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjjettycontextcontroller/BBjJettyContextController_isStarted.htm)

classes.name: BBjAdminEnvironment
classes.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, the BBjAdminEnvironment object provides programmatic access to the BBjServices environment. This may affect other BBj clients.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadminenvironment/bbjadminenvironment.htm)

methods.name: getClasspath
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this BBjAdminEnvironment method returns a vector containing the configured classpath elements for the given session-specific classpath name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadminenvironment/bbjadminenvironment_getclasspath.htm)

methods.name: getFullClasspath
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this BBjAdminEnvironment method returns a vector containing all the classpath elements that affect a session using the given session specific classpath name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadminenvironment/bbjadminenvironment_getfullclasspath.htm)

methods.name: reloadClasspath
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this BBjAdminEnvironment method instructs BBjServices to reload any jar files on the session specific classpath with the given name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadminenvironment/bbjadminenvironment_reloadclasspath.htm)

methods.name: setClasspath
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this BBjAdminEnvironment method configures the value of a classpath name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadminenvironment/bbjadminenvironment_setclasspath.htm)

methods.name: unpinAllPrograms
methods.docu:
In BBj 5.00 and higher, this method unpins all programs BBjServices program cache.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjadminenvironment/bbjadminenvironment_unpinallprograms.htm)

methods.name: unpinServer
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this BBjAdminEnvironment method replaces deprecated BBjAdminEnvironment::unpinAllPrograms. This method unpins programs and resources pinned in the server-wide cache; this does not affect programs or resources pinned with session pinning.

methods.name: closeAll
methods.docu:
attempt to close the MDI Window and all MDI clients within a specified timeout period. Any client that has registered an MDIClosing callback will be polled. If any client vetoes the close then this method immediately returns. If all clients either RELEASE their Interpreter or else call approveMDIClose() within the specified timeout then method will terminate the RuntimeMgr. If the timeout expires before all MDICloseListeners are polled then this method throws BBjException.IO_ERR

Parameters:

  • p_timeoutInSeconds if zero, wait forever.

Returns: boolean returns zero if someone vetoed

classes.name: BBjCookie
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, BBjCookie creates a cookie, a small amount of information sent by a servlet to a Web browser, saved by the browser, and later sent back to the server. A cookie's value can uniquely identify a client, so cookies are commonly used for session management.

A cookie has a name, a single value, and optional attributes such as a comment, path and domain qualifiers, a maximum age, and a version number. Some Web browsers have bugs in how they handle the optional attributes, so use them sparingly to improve the interoperability of your servlets.

The servlet sends cookies to the browser which adds fields to HTTP response headers to send cookies to the browser, one at a time. The browser is expected to support 20 cookies for each Web server, 300 cookies total, and may limit cookie size to 4 KB each.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie.htm)

methods.name: getComment
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the comment from the current BBjCookie object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getComment.htm)

methods.name: getDomain
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the domain within which this cookie should be presented. The form of the domain name is specified by RFC 2109. A domain name begins with a dot (.foo.com) and means that the cookie is visible to servers in a specified Domain Name System (DNS) zone (for example, www.foo.com, but not a.b.foo.com). By default, cookies are only returned to the server that sent them.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getDomain.htm)

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the maximum age of the cookie, specified in seconds, By default, -1 indicating the cookie will persist until browser shutdown.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getMaxAge.htm)

methods.name: getName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the cookie. The name cannot be changed after creation.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getName.htm)

methods.name: getPath
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the path on the server to which the browser returns this BBjCookie. The cookie is visible to all subpaths on the server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getPath.htm)

methods.name: getSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns true if the browser is sending cookies only over a secure protocol, or false if the browser can send cookies using any protocol.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie_getsecure.htm)

methods.name: getValue
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the value from the current BBjCookie object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getValue.htm)

methods.name: getVersion
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the version of the protocol this cookie complies with. Version 1 complies with RFC 2109, and version 0 complies with the original cookie specification drafted by Netscape. Cookies provided by a browser use and identify the browser's cookie version.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_getVersion.htm)

methods.name: setComment
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets a comment that describes a cookie's purpose. The comment is useful if the browser presents the cookie to the user. Comments are not supported by Netscape Version 0 cookies.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setComment.htm)

methods.name: setDomain
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the domain within which this cookie should be presented.

The form of the domain name is specified by RFC 2109. A domain name begins with a dot (.foo.com) and means that the cookie is visible to servers in a specified Domain Name System (DNS) zone (for example, www.foo.com, but not a.b.foo.com). By default, cookies are only returned to the server that sent them.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setDomain.htm)

methods.name: setMaxAge
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the maximum age of the cookie in seconds.

A positive value indicates that the cookie will expire after that many seconds have passed. Note that the value is the maximum age when the cookie will expire, not the cookie's current age.

A negative value means that the cookie is not stored persistently and will be deleted when the Web browser exits. A zero value causes the cookie to be deleted.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setMaxAge.htm)

methods.name: setPath
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the path for the cookie to which the client should return the BBjCookie.

The cookie is visible to all the pages in the directory you specify, and all the pages in that directory's sub-directories. A cookie's path must include the servlet that set the cookie, for example, /catalog, which makes the cookie visible to all directories on the server under /catalog.

Consult RFC 2109 (available on the Internet) for more information on setting path names for cookies.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setPath.htm)

methods.name: setSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method indicates to the browser whether the cookie should only be sent using a secure protocol, such as HTTPS or SSL.

The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setSecure.htm)

methods.name: setValue
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets a new value to a cookie after the cookie is created. If you use a binary value, you may want to use BASE64 encoding. *

With Version 0 cookies, values should not contain white space, brackets, parentheses, equals signs, commas, double quotes, slashes, question marks, at signs, colons, and semicolons. Empty values may not behave the same way on all browsers.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setValue.htm)

methods.name: setVersion
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the version of the cookie protocol this BBjCookie complies with. Version 0 complies with the original Netscape cookie specification. Version 1 complies with RFC 2109.

Since RFC 2109 is still somewhat new, consider version 1 as experimental; do not use it yet on production sites.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/BBjCookie_setVersion.htm)

methods.name: setHttpOnly
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.04 and higher, this method indicates that the cookie should only be sent over HTTP. It can be used to prevent client-side scripts from accessing the cookie.

The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie_sethttponly.htm)

methods.name: isHttpOnly
methods.docu:
In BBj 18.04 and higher, this method returns true if the cookie can only be sent over HTTP.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjcookie/bbjcookie_ishttponly.htm)

methods.name: encodeRedirectURL
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method encodes the specified URL for use in the BBjHttpResponse::sendRedirect(String) method or, if encoding is not needed, returns the URL unchanged. The implementation of this method includes the logic to determine whether the session ID needs to be encoded in the URL. Because the rules for making this determination can differ from those used to decide whether to encode a normal link, this method is separated from the encodeURL method.

All URLs sent to the BBjHttpResponse::sendRedirect(String) method should be run through this method. Otherwise, URL rewriting cannot be used with browsers which do not support cookies.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_encodeRedirectURL.htm)

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method encodes the specified URL by including the session ID in it, or, if encoding is not needed, returns the URL unchanged. The implementation of this method includes the logic to determine whether the session ID needs to be encoded in the URL. For example, if the browser supports cookies, or session tracking is turned off, URL encoding is unnecessary.

For robust session tracking, all URLs emitted by a servlet should be run through this method. Otherwise, URL rewriting cannot be used with browsers which do not support cookies.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_encodeURL.htm)

methods.name: getCharacterEncoding
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the character encoding (MIME charset) used for the body sent in this response. The character encoding may have been specified explicitly using the BBjHttpResponse::setCharacterEncoding(String) or BBjHttpResponse::setContentType(String) methods, or implicitly using the BBjHttpResponse::setLocale(Locale) method. Explicit specifications take precedence over implicit specifications. Calls made to these methods after the response has been committed have no effect on the character encoding. If no character encoding has been specified, ISO-8859-1 is returned.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getCharacterEncoding.htm)

methods.name: getContentType
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the content type used for the MIME body sent in this response. The content type must have been specified using BBjHttpResponse::setContentType(String) before the response is committed. If no content type has been specified, this method returns null(). If a content type has been specified, and a character encoding has been explicitly or implicitly specified, the charset is included in the string returned. If no character encoding has been specified, the charset is omitted.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getContentType.htm)

methods.name: getHeader
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the value of the response header with the given name.

If a response header with the given name exists and contains multiple values, the value that was added first will be returned.

This method considers only response headers set or added via BBjHttpResponse::setHeader(String, String) or BBjHttpResponse::addHeader(String, String), respectively.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getHeader.htm)

methods.name: getHeaderNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing the names of the headers of this response.

This method considers only response headers set or added via BBjHttpResponse::setHeader(String, String), BBjHttpResponse::addHeader(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), respectively.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getHeaderNames.htm)

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing all the values of the specified header from the BBjHttpResponse object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getHeaders.htm)

methods.name: getLocale
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the Locale specified for this BBjHttpResponse using the setLocale(java.util.Locale) method. Calls made to BBjHttpResponse::setLocale(Locale) after the response is committed have no effect. If no locale has been specified, the container's default locale is returned.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getLocale.htm)

methods.name: getStatus
methods.docu:

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_getStatus.htm)

methods.name: sendError
methods.docu:

methods.name: sendError

methods.name: setLocale

This method may be called repeatedly to change locale and character encoding. It does not set the response's character encoding if it is called after BBjHttpResponse::setContentType(String) has been called with a charset specification or after BBjHttpResponse::setCharacterEncoding(String) has been called.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttpresponse/BBjHttpResponse_setLocale.htm)

methods.name: setStatus

In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the status code for the BBjHttpResponse object.

methods.name: getLocale
