In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the preferred Locale that the client will accept content in, based on the Accept-Language header. If the client request doesn't provide an Accept-Language header, this method returns the default locale for the server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocale.htm)

methods.name: getLocales
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the a BBjVector containing Locale objects indicating, in decreasing order starting with the preferred locale, the locales that are acceptable to the client based on the Accept-Language header. If the client request doesn't provide an Accept-Language header, this method returns an Enumeration containing one Locale, the default locale for the server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocales.htm)

methods.name: getLocalName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the host name of the Internet protocol (IP) interface on which the BBjHttpRequest was received.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocalName.htm)

methods.name: getLocalPort
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the Internet protocol (IP) port number of the interface on which the BBjHttpRequest was received.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getLocalPort.htm)

methods.name: getMethod
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the HTTP method with which this request was made.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_getmethod.htm)

methods.name: getParameter
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the value of the named request parameter as a string.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getParameter.htm)

methods.name: getParameterNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector, containing the names of all the parameters passed in by this request.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getParameterNames.htm)

methods.name: getParameterValues
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns all of the parameter values associated with this parameter name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getParameterValues.htm)

methods.name: getPathInfo
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns any extra path information associated with the URL the client sent when it made this BBjHttpRequest.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getPathInfo.htm)

methods.name: getProtocol
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the name and version of the protocol the request uses in the form protocol/majorVersion.minorVersion, for example, HTTP/1.1.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getProtocol.htm)

methods.name: getQueryString
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the query string that is contained in the request URL after the path.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getQueryString.htm)

methods.name: getRemoteAddr
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the Internet protocol (IP) address of the client or last proxy that sent the BBjHttpRequest.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRemoteAddr.htm)

methods.name: getRemoteHost
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the fully qualified name of the client or the last proxy that sent the request. If the engine cannot or chooses not to resolve the hostname (to improve performance), this method returns the dotted-string form of the IP address.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRemoteHost.htm)

methods.name: getRemotePort
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the port number to which the request was sent.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRemotePort.htm)

methods.name: getRemoteUser
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the login of the user making this request, if the user has been authenticated, or null() if the user has not been authenticated.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRemoteUser.htm)

methods.name: getRequestedSessionId
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the session ID specified by the client.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRequestedSessionId.htm)

methods.name: getRequestURI
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the part of this request's URL from the protocol name up to the query string in the first line of the BBjHttpRequest.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRequestURI.htm)

methods.name: getRequestURL
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the URL the client used in the BBjHttpRequest.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getRequestURL.htm)

methods.name: getScheme
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the name of the scheme used to make this request in the BBjHttpRequest, for example, HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getScheme.htm)

methods.name: getServerName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the host-name of the server to which the request was sent. It is the value of the part before ":" in the Host header value, if any, or the resolved server name, or the server IP address.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getServerName.htm)

methods.name: getServerPort
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the port number to which the request was sent. It is the value of the part after ":" in the Host header value, if any, or the server port upon which the client connection was accepted.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getServerPort.htm)

methods.name: getServletPath
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the part of this request's URL that calls the servlet.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getServletPath.htm)

methods.name: getSession
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the BBjHttpSession associated with the BBjHttpRequest.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getSession.htm)

methods.name: isRequestedSessionIdFromCookie
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method checks whether the requested session ID came in as a cookie.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_isRequestedSessionIdFromCookie.htm)

methods.name: isRequestedSessionIdFromURL
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method checks whether the requested session ID came in as part of the request URL.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_isRequestedSessionIdFromURL.htm)

methods.name: isRequestedSessionIdValid
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method checks whether the requested session ID is still valid.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_isRequestedSessionIdValid.htm)

methods.name: isSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this request was made using a secure channel, such as HTTPS.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_isSecure.htm)

methods.name: getFileUploads
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector of BBjFileUpload objects that have been posted and available in a BBjHttpRequest object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getFileUploads.htm)

methods.name: getFileUpload
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjFileUpload object available in a BBjHttpRequest object.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getFileUpload.htm)

methods.name: getBody
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjString object which contains the body of a POSTed request to a servlet.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/BBjHttpRequest_getBody.htm)

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns the value of the named attribute as an Object, or null() if no attribute of the given name exists.

Attributes can be set using BBjHttpRequest::setAttribute(). This allows information to be embedded into a request before a RequestDispatcher call.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_getattribute.htm)

methods.name: getAttributeNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing the names of the attributes available to this request. This method returns an empty BBjVector if the request has no attributes available to it.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_getattributenames.htm)

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method removes an attribute from this request. This method is not generally needed as attributes only persist as long as the request is being handled.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_removeattribute.htm)

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this method stores an attribute in this request. Attributes are reset between requests. This method is most often used in conjunction with BBjHttpResponse::sendRedirect.

Attribute names should follow the same conventions as package names. If the object passed in is null(), the effect is the same as calling BBjHttpRequest::removeAttribute(String).

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/Servlet/bbjhttprequest/bbjhttprequest_setattribute.htm)

classes.name: BBjBuiAppCloseAction
classes.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, the BBjBuiAppCloseAction object provides an interface to chain to another BUI or DWC application on termination of a BUI or DWC application.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiAppCloseAction/BBjBuiAppCloseAction.htm)

methods.name: getActionType
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an integer constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_APP).

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiAppCloseAction/BBjBuiAppCloseAction_getActionType.htm)

methods.name: getActionTypeString
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a string constant identifying the type of this close action (ACTION_APP).

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiAppCloseAction/BBjBuiAppCloseAction_getActionTypeString.htm)

methods.name: getAppName
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the BUI or DWC application name to be run from this close action.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiAppCloseAction/bbjbuiappcloseaction_getappname.htm)

classes.name: BBjBuiCloseAction
classes.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, the BBjBuiCloseAction object provides an interface to configure the termination actions of a BUI or DWC application.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiCloseAction/bbjbuicloseaction.htm)

methods.name: getActionTypeString
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a string constant identifying the type of this close action.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiCloseAction/BBjBuiCloseAction_getActionTypeString.htm)

methods.name: getActionType
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns an integer constant identifying the type of this close action.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bui/BBjBuiCloseAction/bbjbuicloseAction_getactiontype.htm)

classes.name: BBjAppConfig
classes.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, a BBjAppConfig object is used to configure a BUI BBjApplication in preparation for publishing it to the BBjAppServer.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/bbjappconfig.htm)

methods.name: buildApplication
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjApplication object with the values specified in this BBjAppConfig. This next step would normally be to publish the BBjApplication to the BBjAppServer.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_buildApplication.html)

methods.name: clearClientPollInterval
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default setting for the length of time in seconds the web server will wait for the next command from BBjServices.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearClientPollInterval.html)

methods.name: clearDevelopmentMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific development mode setting and uses the server's default setting.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearDevelopmentMode.htm)

methods.name: clearDisallowConsole
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting for whether console access should be disallowed for this application, and uses the server's default setting instead.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearDisallowConsole.htm)

methods.name: clearEndAction
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default application termination action.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearEndAction.html)

methods.name: clearErrAction
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default application error termination action.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearErrAction.html)

methods.name: clearManageBrowserHistory
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting for managing browser history and uses the server's default setting.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearManageBrowserHistory.htm)

methods.name: clearOmitBasisCss
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default OmitBasisCss setting.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearOmitBasisCss.htm)

methods.name: clearSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default setting for whether this application should be started in secure mode.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearSecure.htm)

methods.name: clearSessionTimeout
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default setting for the length of time in seconds a BUI session will be considered active.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearSessionTimeout.html)

methods.name: clearShowBrowserWarning
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default setting for whether to show a browser warning the first time the user attempts to run a BUI application in Internet Explorer 8.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearShowBrowserWarning.html)

methods.name: clearShowClientConfirmationDialog
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method clears any application-specific setting and uses the server's default setting for whether to show a confirmation dialog when the user attempts to leave the application's page.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_clearShowClientConfirmationDialog.html)

methods.name: getApplicationIcon
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjResourceUrl representing a URL for the application's icon.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getApplicationIcon.html)

methods.name: getApplicationUserName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application user name, which corresponds to the BBj -n parameter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getApplicationUserName.html)

methods.name: getBBjApplicationName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application name, which corresponds to the BBj -a parameter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getBBjApplicationName.html)

methods.name: getClasspathName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application classpath name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getClasspathName.html)

methods.name: getClientPollInterval
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method is the length of time in seconds the web server will wait for the next command from the server. The default value is 50 seconds. If the web server does not receive a command from BBjServices in the configured time period, it will send a heartbeat to the browser.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getClientPollInterval.html)

methods.name: getConfigFile
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the config.bbx file name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getConfigFile.html)

methods.name: getDevelopmentMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this BUI app should be run in development mode. The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getDevelopmentMode.htm)

methods.name: getDisallowConsole
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this BUI app is set to disallow console access.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getDisallowConsole.htm)

methods.name: getEndAction
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the action that occurs on normal application termination.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getEndAction.html)

methods.name: getErrAction
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns the action that occurs on abnormal application termination.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getErrAction.html)

methods.name: getInterpreterUser
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the interpreter user name, which corresponds to the BBj -u command line parameter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getInterpreterUser.html)

methods.name: getLoadImage
methods.docu:
In BBj 14.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjResourceUrl representing the application's load image.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getLoadImage.html)

methods.name: getManageBrowserHistory
methods.docu:
In BBj 16.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether BUI will manage this app's browser history. The default value is false .

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getManageBrowserHistory.htm)

methods.name: getOmitBasisCss
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this BUI app should be run without the default BASIS CSS. The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getOmitBasisCss.htm)

methods.name: getProgramArguments
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the user-defined program arguments for this program.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getProgramArguments.html)

methods.name: getProgramName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the BBj program name for this application.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getProgramName.html)

methods.name: getSecure
methods.docu:
In BBj 19.10 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether this application should be started in secure mode. The default value is false.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getSecure.htm)

methods.name: getSessionTimeout
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the number of seconds a non-responsive BUI application will be considered active. If this time passes with no response, the web tier will send a NET_DROPPED error back to the server. The default value is 300 seconds (5 minutes). -1 corresponds to no timeout.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getSessionTimeout.html)

methods.name: getShowBrowserWarning
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether a browser warning page should be shown the first time the user attempts to run a BUI application in Internet Explorer 8. The default value is true.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getShowBrowserWarning.html)

methods.name: getShowClientConfirmationDialog
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether to display a confirmation dialog when the user attempts to leave the application's page. The default value is true.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getShowClientConfirmationDialog.html)

methods.name: getStyleSheet
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjResourceUrl object representing the URL for an application's style sheet.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getStyleSheet.html)

methods.name: getTerminal
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the terminal ID to be used for this application.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getTerminal.html)

methods.name: getWorkingDirectory
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns the application working directory.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_getWorkingDirectory.html)

methods.name: isBuiEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method returns whether this application is enabled in the BUI client.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_isBuiEnabled.htm)

methods.name: isDwcEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method returns whether this application is enabled in the DWC client.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_isDwcEnabled.html)

methods.name: isDesktopEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 24.01 and higher, this method returns a boolean indicating whether or not this application is enabled for desktop deployment.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_isDesktopEnabled.htm)

methods.name: isQuiet
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method returns whether this application should be started in quiet mode.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_isQuiet.html)

methods.name: makeCopy
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method makes a copy of this BBjAppConfig.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_makeCopy.html)

methods.name: setApplicationIcon
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the icon to appear in the browser tab beside the application name.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_setApplicationIcon.html)

methods.name: setApplicationUserName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this methods sets the application user name, which corresponds to the BBj -n parameter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_setApplicationUserName.html)

methods.name: setBBjApplicationName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the application name, which corresponds to the BBj -a parameter.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_setBBjApplicationName.html)

methods.name: setBuiEnabled
methods.docu:
In BBj 21.10 and higher, this method sets whether this application is enabled in the BUI client.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_setBuiEnabled.htm)

methods.name: setClasspathName
methods.docu:
In BBj 12.00 and higher, this method sets the application classpath.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjappconfig/BBjAppConfig_setClasspathName.html)

methods.name: setClientPollInterval
methods.docu:

methods.name: getProcess
methods.docu:
This is a dangerous method.  It allows one to get the BBjProcess
that's currently running.  The point of this is to be able to debug
problems by inspecting objects in the current process.  BBjProcess
has the root of almost all the objects used in a running session, so
we return it from this method.

methods.name: userTypes
methods.docu:
user interaction commands here is a sample

LET myAPI!=BBjAPI()
SYSGUI=UNT
OPEN (SYSGUI) "X0"
LET mySysGui!=myAPI!.getSysGui()
myWindow! = mySysGui!.addWindow(10,10,200,300,"interaction sample")
myButton! = myWindow!.addButton(101,10,10,90,30,"STOP",$0800$)
myButton!.setCallback(myButton!.ON_BUTTON_PUSH,"STOP_BUTTON_PUSHED")
myButton2! = myWindow!.addButton(102,10,50,90,30,"START",$0800$)
myButton2!.setCallback(myButton2!.ON_BUTTON_PUSH,"START_BUTTON_PUSHED")
myButton3! = myWindow!.addButton(103,10,90,90,30,"RUN",$0800$)
myButton3!.setCallback(myButton3!.ON_BUTTON_PUSH,"RUN_BUTTON_PUSHED")
myButton4! = myWindow!.addButton(104,10,130,90,30,"STUFF",$0800$)
myButton4!.setCallback(myButton4!.ON_BUTTON_PUSH,"STUFF_BUTTON_PUSHED")

myCEdit! = myWindow!.addCEdit(110,50,200,90,30,"",$0008$)
myWindow!.setCallback(myWindow!.ON_CLOSE,"APP_CLOSE")
t! = bbjapi().getTest()
PROCESS_EVENTS
START_BUTTON_PUSHED:
t!.startMacro()
RETURN
STOP_BUTTON_PUSHED:
mac$ = t!.endMacro()
print mac$
RETURN
RUN_BUTTON_PUSHED:
execute mac$
RETURN
STUFF_BUTTON_PUSHED:
t!.mouseClick(myCedit!)
t!.userTypes("hello")
RETURN
APP_CLOSE:
RELEASE
RETURN

methods.name: testPublicAPIs
methods.docu:
This method goes through the Primitives declared in TypeResolver and
 makes sure none of the interfaces extends interfaces that are not in
 com.basis.bbj.* and NOT in com.basis.bbj.proxies.internal

 This comes about because a great many of the interfaces extend AutoWrappable
 Which causes the methods of AutoWrappable to be exposed to the user.

methods.name: dieAfter
methods.docu:
Use to kill the current process after a certain amount of time. p_ms is the number of milliseconds it should wait, and p_status is the exit code it should use.

Parameters:

  • p_ms Milliseconds to wait
  • p_status exit code to use, use one of #OK, #FAIL, #SKIP, or #ERROR.

In BBj 7.00 and higher, this object provides the functionality of the traditional templated string and can be used throughout BBj in places where a templated string can be used.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjtemplatedstring/bbjtemplatedstring.htm)

classes.docu:

classes.name: BBjString
classes.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, the BBjString object defines an object-oriented interface to traditional BBx strings. It implements most of the methods defined by java.lang.String. This API is primarily designed to facilitate interaction with Java libraries.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString.htm)

methods.name: charAt
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the char value at the specified index. An index ranges from 0 to BBjString::length() - 1. The first char value of the sequence is at index 0, the next at index 1, and so on, as for array indexing.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_charAt.htm)

methods.name: codePointAt
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method r eturns the character (Unicode code point) at the specified index. The index refers to char values (Unicode code units) and ranges from 0 to BBjString::length() - 1.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_codePointAt.htm)

methods.name: codePointBefore
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method r eturns the character (Unicode code point) before the specified index. The index refers to char values (Unicode code units) and ranges from 1 to BBjString::length().

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_codePointBefore.htm)

methods.name: codePointCount
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns the number of Unicode code points in the specified text range of this String. The text range begins at the specified beginIndex and extends to the char at index endIndex - 1. Thus the length (in chars) of the text range is endIndex-beginIndex. Unpaired surrogates within the text range count as one code point each.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_codePointCount.htm)

methods.name: compareTo
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method compares two strings lexicographically. The comparison is based on the Unicode value of each character in the strings. The character sequence represented by this String object is compared lexicographically to the character sequence represented by the argument string. The result is a negative integer if this String object lexicographically precedes the argument string. The result is a positive integer if this String object lexicographically follows the argument string. The result is zero if the strings are equal; compareTo returns 0 exactly when the BBjString::equals(Object) method would return true.

This is the definition of lexicographic ordering. If two strings are different, then either they have different characters at some index that is a valid index for both strings, or their lengths are different, or both. If they have different characters at one or more index positions, let k be the smallest such index; then the string whose character at position k has the smaller value, as determined by using the < operator, lexicographically precedes the other string. In this case, compareTo returns the difference of the two character values at position k in the two string -- that is, the value:

this.charAt(k)-anotherString.charAt(k)
If there is no index position at which they differ, then the shorter string lexicographically precedes the longer string. In this case, compareTo returns the difference of the lengths of the strings -- that is, the value: 
this.length()-anotherString.length()
[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_compareTo.htm)

methods.name: compareToIgnoreCase
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method compares two strings lexicographically, ignoring case differences. This method returns an integer whose sign is that of calling BBjString::compareTo(String) with normalized versions of the strings where case differences have been eliminated by calling Character.toLowerCase(Character.toUpperCase(character)) on each character.

Note that this method does not take locale into account, and will result in an unsatisfactory ordering for certain locales. The java.text package provides collators to allow locale-sensitive ordering.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_compareToIgnoreCase.htm)

methods.name: concat
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method concatenates the specified string to the end of this string.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_concat.htm)

methods.name: intern
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a canonical representation for the string object.

A pool of strings, initially empty, is maintained privately by the class String.

When the intern method is invoked, if the pool already contains a string equal to this String object as determined by the BBjString::equals(Object) method, then the string from the pool is returned. Otherwise, this String object is added to the pool and a reference to this String object is returned.

It follows that for any two strings s and t, s.intern() == t.intern() is true if and only if s.equals(t) is true.

All literal strings and string-valued constant expressions are interned. String literals are defined in section 3.10.5 of the The Java™ Language Specification.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_intern.htm)

For other values of ch, it is the largest value k such that: this.codePointAt(k) == ch is true. In either case, if no such character occurs in this string, then -1 is returned. The String is searched backwards starting at the last character.

methods.name: regionMatches
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method tests if two string regions are equal.

A substring of this String object is compared to a substring of the argument other. The result is true if these substrings represent identical character sequences. The substring of this String object to be compared begins at index toffset and has length len. The substring of other to be compared begins at index ooffset and has length len. The result is false if and only if at least one of the following is true:

  • toffset is negative.
  • ooffset is negative.
  • toffset+len is greater than the length of this String object.
  • ooffset+len is greater than the length of the other argument.
  • ignoreCase is false and there is some nonnegative integer k less than len such that:
    this.charAt(toffset+k) != other.charAt(ooffset+k)

  • ignoreCase is true and there is some nonnegative integer k less than len such that:
    Character.toLowerCase(this.charAt(toffset+k)) != Character.toLowerCase(other.charAt(ooffset+k))
    and:
    Character.toUpperCase(this.charAt(toffset+k)) != Character.toUpperCase(other.charAt(ooffset+k))

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_regionMatches.htm)

The replacement proceeds from the beginning of the string to the end, for example, replacing "aa" with "b" in the string "aaa" will result in "ba" rather than "ab".

An invocation of this method of the form str.replaceAll(regex, repl) yields exactly the same result as the expression:

Pattern.compile(regex).replaceAll(repl)

Note that backslashes (\) and dollar signs ($) in the replacement string may cause the results to be different than if it were being treated as a literal replacement string; see replaceAll. Use Matcher#quoteReplacement to suppress the special meaning of these characters, if desired.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_replaceAll.htm)

An invocation of this method of the form str.replaceFirst(regex, repl) yields exactly the same result as the expression:

compile(regex).matcher(str).replaceFirst(repl)

Note that backslashes (\) and dollar signs ($) in the replacement string may cause the results to be different than if it were being treated as a literal replacement string; see Matcher.replaceFirst. Use Matcher.quoteReplacement to suppress the special meaning of these characters, if desired.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_replaceFirst.htm)

methods.name: split
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method splits this string around matches of the given regular expression.

The one-argument method works as if by invoking the two-argument split method with the given expression and a limit argument of zero. Trailing empty strings are therefore not included in the resulting array.

The string "boo:and:foo", for example, yields the following results with these expressions:

Regex Result

:

{"boo", "and", "foo"}

o

{"b", "", ":and:f"}

methods.name: toLowerCase
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method converts all of the characters in this String to lower case using the rules of the default locale. This is equivalent to calling toLowerCase(Locale.getDefault()).

NOTE: This method is locale sensitive, and may produce unexpected results if used for strings that are intended to be interpreted locale independently. Examples are programming language identifiers, protocol keys, and HTML tags. For instance, "TITLE".toLowerCase() in a Turkish locale returns "t\u0131tle", where '\u0131' is the LATIN SMALL LETTER DOTLESS I character. To obtain correct results for locale insensitive strings, use toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_toLowerCase.htm)

methods.name: trim
methods.docu:
In BBj 7.00 and higher, this method returns a string whose value is this string, with any leading and trailing whitespace removed.

If this String object represents an empty character sequence, or the first and last characters of character sequence represented by this String object both have codes greater than '\u0020' (the space character), then a reference to this String object is returned.

Otherwise, if there is no character with a code greater than '\u0020' in the string, then a String object representing an empty string is returned.

Otherwise, let k be the index of the first character in the string whose code is greater than '\u0020', and let m be the index of the last character in the string whose code is greater than '\u0020'. A String object is returned, representing the substring of this string that begins with the character at index k and ends with the character at index m-that is, the result of this.substring(k, m + 1).

This method may be used to trim whitespace (as defined above) from the beginning and end of a string.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/API/bbjstring/BBjString_trim.htm)

classes.name: BBjEnterpriseNamespace

classes.name: BBjJettyContextConfiguration
classes.docu:
In BBj 15.00 and higher, this class allows the configuration of web contexts within the Jetty Server. This class is used to programmatically configure these contexts.

Each context can contain a unique set of BBxServlets, BUI applications, JNLP application and static content.

To access the main BBj context, which is the default context for all applications, use the BBjJettyServerConfiguration::getRootContextInfo() method.

The context path is the prefix of a URL path that is used to select the context to which an incoming request is passed.

Typically a URL in a BBxServlet is in the format http://hostname:8888/contextPath/servlet/servletPath, where each of the path elements can be zero or more / separated elements. If there is no context path, the context is referred to as the root context. The root context must be configured as '/'.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettycontextconfiguration/BBjJettyContextConfiguration.htm)

methods.name: createMDIWindow

   X = SCALL("bbj ...<someProgram> ....&)

Any windows created by <someProgram> display within the user area of the BBjMDI window.

methods.name: setDefaultMDIMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method sets the default MDIMode that will be used when new BBjSessions are launched within this MDI.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjmdi/bbjmdi_setdefaultmdimode.htm)

methods.name: getDefaultMDIMode
methods.docu:
In BBj 9.00 and higher, this method returns the default MDIMode that will be used when new BBjSessions are launched within this MDI.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/bbjmdi/bbjmdi_getdefaultmdimode.htm)

classes.name: BBjJettyServer
classes.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this class provides an administrator program the ability to control the running BBJ Web Server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer.htm)

methods.name: isRunning
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a boolean value that indicates whether the Jetty server is running.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_isRunning.htm)

methods.name: start
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method will start the integrated Jetty Server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_start.htm)

methods.name: stop
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method will stop the integrated Jetty Server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_stop.htm)

methods.name: restart
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method will restart the integrated Jetty Server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_restart.htm)

methods.name: getContextNames
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjVector containing the names of the configured contexts within the integrated Jetty Server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_getContextNames.htm)

methods.name: getContext
methods.docu:
In BBj 17.00 and higher, this method returns a BBjJettyContextController that can control a running context within the integrated Jetty Server.

[Docs](https://documentation.basis.cloud/BASISHelp/WebHelp/bbjobjects/admin/bbjjettyserver/BBjJettyServer_getContext.htm)
